documented_synthesis: Early PLC field applications and performance evaluations preceded the 2020s market transition.
interpretation_limit: Documented trials and studies, not national readiness or prevalence.
inference_boundary: Direct historical documentation; not causal attribution.

documented_synthesis: Type IL standardization and selected DOT use/acceptance existed before 2020.
interpretation_limit: Earlier ASTM C1157 project use differs from formal Type IL acceptance.
inference_boundary: Do not conflate specifications or infer purchases.

documented_synthesis: Public records document manufacturer PLC commitments, transitions, and reported production at different dates and evidence scopes.
interpretation_limit: Announcements and scheduled transitions do not prove plant-level operational availability.
inference_boundary: Plant-specific evidence must retain Module 01 evidence status.

documented_synthesis: USGS annual shipment aggregates provide a historical market series for Portland and blended cement categories.
interpretation_limit: Blended cement includes non-PLC products; coverage and comparability not audited.
inference_boundary: Cannot estimate PLC adoption or causally attribute changes.

documented_synthesis: Compiled state DOT first-acceptance dates document staggered permission across states.
interpretation_limit: Dates are compiled at month precision; acceptance is not actual procurement.

documented_synthesis: California documents show a transition from 2020 consideration to 2021 Type IL specification acceptance and implementation guidance.
interpretation_limit: California-specific case; distinct documents can share underlying decision process.

documented_synthesis: Documented RMX producers and projects reported trial batching, qualification work, and adjustments when using PLC.
interpretation_limit: Selected cases and surveys; do not infer national frequency or average costs.

documented_synthesis: Documented downstream actors reported storage constraints and cement-source transitions affecting material choices.
interpretation_limit: Survey responses and individual cases; source transition is not evidence of universal forced adoption.
inference_boundary: Potential supply-mediated mechanism, not measured effect size.

documented_synthesis: Surveyed producers reported changes in water demand, strength, and admixture use; results varied by context.
interpretation_limit: Nonrepresentative samples; reported responses are not universal material properties.

documented_synthesis: Documented municipal procurement and public low-carbon initiatives introduced new requirements or trials for concrete.
interpretation_limit: Many policies address concrete embodied carbon generally, not PLC exclusively.
inference_boundary: Chronology does not establish effect on PLC shipments.

documented_synthesis: Industry outreach, EPD disclosure, federal initiatives, and procurement criteria were documented during and after market transition.
interpretation_limit: Some events postdate initial acceleration; broad policy not PLC-specific.

documented_synthesis: Case evidence documents investment, grinding efficiency, and commercial incentives in particular manufacturer operations.
interpretation_limit: Sparse selected cases, including projections and non-PLC-specific investments.
inference_boundary: Cannot infer representative national economics or calibrate coefficients.

documented_synthesis: DOT evidence documents different technical, environmental, and supply-related considerations in different agencies and periods.
interpretation_limit: Motivations are agency- and time-specific; 2009 trial and 2023 shortage are separate events.
inference_boundary: Do not construct continuous causal chain.

documented_synthesis: Technical and standards evidence predates multiple later commercial and policy signals, but available records alone do not identify the cause of acceleration.
interpretation_limit: Cross-module synthesis; observed USGS blended shipments are not PLC-only.
inference_boundary: Temporal ordering is descriptive, not causal identification.
